metadata.description: Synthetic example prices associated with European fuel retail brand labels for application fixtures and demos. NOT measured or scraped prices; station identities are fictional.
limitations: No provided price is a real per-station or brand price. Do not display as live/verified.
DEMO-* station IDs do not match OSM, BenzynaMAPA, MIMIT or other provider identifiers.
Coordinates are null; map integration requires real stations from a separately licensed provider.
A brand-country pair is illustrative; country assignments are not an exhaustive audit of where brands trade.
null indicates unavailable/unspecified fuel in this sample, not confirmed absence at a real station.
pb95 is a convenience label; actual E5/E10 grades differ by market.
metadata.conversion_note: Prices were converted from the previous synthetic local-currency fixture using illustrative, non-market FX rates. Not real observed prices or rates.
metadata.fx_rates_update_policy: Demo only. Replace rates with a licensed/live provider and timestamp before real use.
